title: Behaviour of the UE in state 5GMM-DEREGISTERED and state 5GMM-REGISTERED

entities.name: 5GMM-DEREGISTERED
entities.description: UE state where it is not registered with the network.

entities.name: 5GMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: UE state where it is registered with the network.

entities.name: UE behaviour
entities.description: Specifies the actions and responses of the UE in different 5GMM states.

relations.description: UE behaviour is defined for the 5GMM-DEREGISTERED state.
UE behaviour is defined for the 5GMM-REGISTERED state.
UE transitions from 5GMM-DEREGISTERED to 5GMM-REGISTERED upon successful registration.
UE transitions from 5GMM-REGISTERED to 5GMM-DEREGISTERED upon de-registration.
